mapper.select: SELECT id AS receipt_id,receipt_no,order_id,attempt_id,amount,currency,disposition,refunded_amount,refund_reserved_amount,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,provider_transaction_no FROM tc_payment_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{receipt} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id AS receipt_id,receipt_no,order_id,attempt_id,amount,currency,disposition,refunded_amount,refund_reserved_amount,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,provider_transaction_no FROM tc_payment_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND receipt_no=#{number}

SELECT id AS receipt_id,receipt_no,order_id,attempt_id,amount,currency,disposition,refunded_amount,refund_reserved_amount,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,provider_transaction_no FROM tc_payment_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND receipt_no=#{number} FOR UPDATE

SELECT reservation_no,refund_no,receipt_id,receipt_no,order_id,amount,currency,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,state,provider_refund_no,submitted_at,provider_succeeded_at,confirmed_at,released_at,evidence_ref FROM tc_payment_refund_hold WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_no=#{refund}

SELECT reservation_no,refund_no,receipt_id,receipt_no,order_id,amount,currency,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,state,provider_refund_no,submitted_at,provider_succeeded_at,confirmed_at,released_at,evidence_ref FROM tc_payment_refund_hold WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_no=#{refund} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_payment_refund_hold(tenant_id,reservation_no,refund_no,receipt_id,receipt_no,order_id,amount,currency,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{reservation},#{refund},#{receipt},#{receiptNo},#{order},#{amount},#{currency},#{channel},#{merchant},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_payment_refund_hold.id
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_payment_refund_hold SET state='SUBMITTED',submitted_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_no=#{refund} AND state='HELD'

UPDATE tc_payment_receipt SET refund_reserved_amount=refund_reserved_amount-#{amount},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{receipt} AND refund_reserved_amount >= #{amount}
UPDATE tc_payment_refund_hold SET state='RELEASED',released_at=#{now},evidence_ref=#{evidence},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_no=#{refund} AND state=#{expected}

UPDATE tc_payment_receipt SET refund_reserved_amount=refund_reserved_amount-#{amount},refunded_amount=refunded_amount+#{amount},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{receipt} AND refund_reserved_amount >= #{amount}
